Object P moves at a constant speed of 5m/s repeatedly backwards and forwards in a straight
line.
Object Q moves at a constant speed of 5m/s vertically downwards.
Object R moves at a constant speed of 5m/s in a circle.
Which objects are moving with uniform velocity?
A
P only
B
Q only
C
R only
D
Q and R
